raw_text:
PLAN "12-Week Vegan Muscle Gain"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Build muscle mass (hypertrophy) over 12 weeks"

PHASES
  PHASE "Phase 1 - Foundation (Weeks 1-4)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper Push / Horizontal":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          triceps_rope_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 60m "Lower - Strength/Hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          rower 8m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_back_squat 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          hanging_knee_raise 3x10..15 rpe 7 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 60m "Upper Pull / Vertical":
        warmup:
          ski_erg 8m
        main straight_sets:
          pull_up_assisted 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_barbell_row 3x8..10 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          single_arm_dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          dumbbell_biceps_curl 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          thoracic_rotation 5m
    WEEK 2:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper Push / Horizontal":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          triceps_rope_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_stretch 5m
    WEEK 3:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Upper Push / Horizontal":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 7 rest 120 seconds
          incline_dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          seated_cable_row 3x8..12 rpe 7 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_lateral_raise 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          triceps_rope_pushdown 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_stretch 5m
    WEEK 4:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Deload/Technique":
        warmup:
          bike 6m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_bench_press 3x5..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_back_squat 3x5..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          deadlift_rack_pull 3x5..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility_flow 8m

  PHASE "Phase 2 - Build (Weeks 5-8)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 5:
      DAY Monday training 65m "Push Emphasis":
        warmup:
          assault_bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_barbell_press 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          incline_dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          cable_crossbody_raise 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          skullcrusher_dumbbell 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 70m "Leg Hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          rower 8m
        main straight_sets:
          front_squat 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          leg_curl_machine 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          seated_calf_raise 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 65m "Pull Volume":
        warmup:
          ski_erg 8m
        main straight_sets:
          weighted_pull_up_or_assisted 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_barbell_row 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          chest_supported_row 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_biceps_curl 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          reverse_fly 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 5m
    WEEK 6:
      DAY Monday training 65m "Push Emphasis":
        warmup:
          assault_bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_bench_press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          overhead_barbell_press 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          incline_dumbbell_press 3x8..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          cable_crossbody_raise 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          skullcrusher_dumbbell 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_stretch 5m
    WEEK 7:
      DAY Monday training 65m "Upper Mixed":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_barbell_bench 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          weighted_dips_assisted 3x6..8 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          single_arm_cable_row 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          lateral_raise_cable 3x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          hammer_curl 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          shoulder_mobility 5m
    WEEK 8:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Deload - Volume Reduction":
        warmup:
          rower 6m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_bench_press 3x5..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          front_squat 3x5..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_barbell_row 3x5..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility_flow 8m

  PHASE "Phase 3 - Intensify & Peak (Weeks 9-12)" (4 weeks):
    WEEK 9:
      DAY Monday training 70m "Upper Power/Hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          assault_bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_barbell_bench 5x5..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          overhead_barbell_press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          chest_supported_row 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_lateral_raise 4x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          triceps_dip_assisted 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_stretch 5m
      DAY Wednesday training 75m "Lower Heavy/Accessory":
        warmup:
          bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_back_squat 5x5..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          deadlift 3x3..5 rpe 8 rest 180 seconds
          walking_lunge 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          leg_press 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 4x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 5m
      DAY Friday training 70m "Pull Volume/Intensity":
        warmup:
          ski_erg 8m
        main straight_sets:
          weighted_pull_up_or_assisted 5x5..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          bent_over_barbell_row 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          single_arm_dumbbell_row 3x10..12 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          face_pull 4x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          barbell_biceps_curl 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          lat_stretch 5m
    WEEK 10:
      DAY Monday training 70m "Upper Power/Hypertrophy":
        warmup:
          assault_bike 8m
        main straight_sets:
          incline_barbell_bench 5x5..6 rpe 8 rest 150 seconds
          overhead_barbell_press 4x6..8 rpe 8 rest 120 seconds
          chest_supported_row 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          dumbbell_lateral_raise 4x12..15 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
          triceps_dip_assisted 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          pec_stretch 5m
    WEEK 11:
      DAY Monday training 65m "Unilateral & Density":
        warmup:
          rower 8m
        main straight_sets:
          single_leg_squat_box 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          romanian_deadlift_single_leg 3x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          single_arm_dumbbell_row 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          incline_dumbbell_press 4x8..10 rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
          farmer_carry 3x60s rpe 8 rest 90 seconds
        cooldown:
          full_body_stretch 8m
    WEEK 12:
      DAY Monday training 60m "Deload / Assessment":
        warmup:
          bike 6m
        main straight_sets:
          barbell_bench_press 3x5..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          barbell_back_squat 3x5..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          bent_over_barbell_row 3x5..6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
        cooldown:
          mobility_flow 8m

NUTRITION
  MACROS:
    calories "Surplus: +250 kcal above maintenance (adjust per progress)"
    protein "150 g plant-based protein per day"
    carbs "45-55% of calories"
    fats "20-30% of calories"
  GUIDELINES:
    - "Achieve 150 g protein/day using varied plant sources: soy (tofu, tempeh, edamame), seitan, lentils, chickpeas, black beans, green peas, textured vegetable protein (TVP), pea protein and rice protein powders, quinoa, and nut/seed butters."
    - "Include a protein source at every meal and snack. Aim for ~30-40 g protein per main meal and 10-20 g per snack."
    - "Use fortified plant milks and cereals for calcium, B12 supplement daily, consider omega-3 (algal) supplement."
    - "Post-workout: 20-30 g fast-absorbing plant protein (pea/rice blend) with 30-50 g carbs within 1-2 hours."
    - "Distribute calories evenly across 3 meals + 1-2 snacks to support recovery and muscle protein synthesis."
    - "Track weight and adjust calories if weight gain <0.25 kg/week after 2 weeks or fat gain excessive."
  SAMPLE_DAY:
    breakfast:
      - "Tofu scramble with vegetables + 2 slices whole-grain toast + 1 serving fortified plant milk (approx 30-35 g protein)"
    lunch:
      - "Tempeh or seitan bowl with quinoa, mixed vegetables, and tahini dressing (approx 35-40 g protein)"
    snack:
      - "Pea-protein shake (20-25 g protein) + a banana"
    dinner:
      - "Lentil and chickpea curry with brown rice + side salad + mixed seeds (approx 35-40 g protein)"
    evening_snack:
      - "Nut butter on whole-grain crackers or soy yogurt with protein powder (10-15 g protein)"

NOTES
  - "Programme assumes no exercise contraindications; avoid any movements causing pain and substitute as needed."
  - "Nutrition plan is plant-only and includes supplementation recommendations for B12 and algal omega-3; consider vitamin D if deficient."
